cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import subprocess, sys, json, time
# 8 runs, 10k-flow WFQ table, mixed policies
flows = [[i, (i % 1024) + 1] for i in range(10000)]
runs = []
for k in range(8):
    pol = [{"kind":"wfq","weights":flows}, {"kind":"sp","levels":[[i,i%50] for i in range(10000)]},
           {"kind":"fifo"}, {"kind":"sff"}][k % 4]
    runs.append({"banks":16,"load_balancers":8,"fifo_bytes":1000,"pifo_bytes":1000,
                 "refill_batch":32,"sample_period":10,"borders":[0,7,99,500,1000],
                 "policy":pol,
                 "events":[["enqueue",i,i%10000,10,i%1000] for i in range(1000)]
                         + [["save",1],["dequeue",50],["restore",1],["sample"],
                            ["repartition",[0,3,100,1000]],["dequeue",50]]})
data = json.dumps({"runs":runs}).encode()
t0=time.monotonic()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","-B","submission/cli.py"],input=data,capture_output=True)
t1=time.monotonic()
out = json.loads(p.stdout)
ok = (p.returncode==0 and len(out["runs"])==8
      and all(len(r["log"])>0 for r in out["runs"])
      and out["runs"][0]["state"]["policy"]["kind"]=="wfq"
      and len(out["runs"][0]["state"]["policy"]["weights"])==10000)
print("8-run mixed:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL", f"wall {t1-t0:.2f}s out {len(p.stdout)//1024}KiB")
print("wfq cert sample:", json.dumps(out["runs"][0]["state"]["policy"])[:120])
print("sp cert len:", len(out["runs"][1]["state"]["policy"]["levels"]))
EOF

cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
# submission format compliance
import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace')
from submission_paths import validate_relative_path
import stat
total = entries = 0
root = 'submission'
for base, dirs, files in os.walk(root, followlinks=False):
    rel = os.path.relpath(base, root)
    for name in dirs + files:
        p = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(rel, name)).replace('./','')
        validate_relative_path(p)
        full = os.path.join(base, name)
        st = os.lstat(full)
        entries += 1
        assert not stat.S_ISLNK(st.st_mode), full
        if stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode):
            assert st.st_nlink == 1, full
            total += st.st_size
print("entries:", entries, "(cap 256)  bytes:", total, "(cap", 8*1024**2, ")")
open('submission/cli.py','rb').read().decode('utf-8')
print("cli.py is UTF-8: OK")
EOF
